text:
anya: Ok team — proposing a short field pilot: create a 'pricing sandbox' for 3 enterprise customers to test add-ons (priority-lane, burst credits, quantized models). Launch criteria: 2 customers complete a 2-week run with no QoS regressions, SLOs met, billing clarity. Need product + sales + legal signoff by next Wed. Thoughts?
jess: sounds good. can we limit burst credits to 5x baseline and cap daily cost exposure? sales asked for a softcap.
sam: from eng perspective need: token-level cost telemetry, per-route throttles; runtime changes minimal. ETA 2 sprints for telemetry.
mike-sales: I'll line up customers: FinTech client and Gaming studio. Both need NDA + PCI notes. They want a dedicated support window. expect pricing asks ~20% discount for pilot.
anya: noted — legal constraints? @laura-legal
laura-legal: We can do NDA + limited pilot T&Cs. Need to cap liability and add data deletion clause. Will draft by Fri.
eng-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/price-sandbox-telemetry -> staging at 2026-03-05 14:00 UTC
mike-sales: :thumbsup: For launch criteria, add 'billing clarity' — customers must be able to forecast cost within 10%.
jess: q: do we expose burst charges on invoice or keep it as a hidden usage bucket? prefer transparent line-item.
anya: prefer transparent. Add-on SKU per token with unit price + optional cap/ceiling. Also need rollback plan — auto-fallback to base model if cost > threshold.
sam: fallback implemented as routing policy. quick config example:
```
routing_rule:
  if spend_24h > 5000 USD or latency_p95 > 250ms:
    route_to: 'base-model'
    notify: ops
```

sam: note — if we give reserved capacity per pilot we'll need KV cache isolation; small infra cost.
tom-sales: Ops + CS want a runbook and customer-facing FAQ. I'll draft.
jess: add metrics to acceptance: 'unit cost per 1k tokens' and 'missed-SLO incidents' — want both under X.
anya: OK next steps: 1) eng finalize telemetry & fallback (sam) 2) legal draft T&Cs (laura) 3) sales confirm customers & expectations (mike/tom) 4) product write launch checklist. Deadline: next Wed EOD. Any pushback?
mike-sales: no objections. need to confirm quantized model licensing with research/ops.
sam: can we add a cheap guardrail: daily hard cap that auto-suspends add-on instead of billing spike?
jess: yes — prefer auto-suspend + customer alert email + billing estimate.
anya: perfect. I'll update the PRD and ping when PRD is updated. thanks all.
